title: Global News Map
description: *Global News Map* is a **world map of the day's news**. Every story from Wikipedia's Current Events portal is pinned where it happened, with the sources it was reported by, and any past day can be opened.

I chose the data path: Wikipedia geotags places but not ideas, so the **articles a story links are its candidate locations**, and the smallest one wins. That puts the pin on the town instead of the country.

The map is **drawn from coastline data the page carries itself**, with no tile server, so it needs no API key and no account. The projection, parsing and ranking are **covered by tests written before the code**.
